# read-pkg [![Build Status](https://example.invalid/sindresorhus/read-pkg.svg?branch=master)](https://example.invalid/sindresorhus/read-pkg)

> Read a package.json file


## Why

- [Gracefully handles filesystem issues](https://example.invalid/isaacs/node-graceful-fs)
- [Strips UTF-8 BOM](https://example.invalid/sindresorhus/strip-bom)
- [Throws more helpful JSON errors](https://example.invalid/sindresorhus/parse-json)
- [Normalizes the data](https://example.invalid/npm/normalize-package-data#what-normalization-currently-entails)


## Install

```
$ npm install read-pkg
```


## Usage

```js
const readPkg = require('read-pkg');

readPkg().then(pkg => {
	console.log(pkg);
	//=> {name: 'read-pkg', ...}
});

readPkg(__dirname).then(pkg => {
	console.log(pkg);
	//=> {name: 'read-pkg', ...}
});

readPkg(path.join('unicorn', 'package.json')).then(pkg => {
	console.log(pkg);
	//=> {name: 'read-pkg', ...}
});
```


## API

### readPkg([path], [options])

Returns a `Promise` for the parsed JSON.

### readPkg.sync([path], [options])

Returns the parsed JSON.

#### path

Type: `string`<br>
Default: `process.cwd()`

Path to a `package.json` file or its directory.

#### options

##### normalize

Type: `boolean`<br>
Default: `true`

[Normalize](https://example.invalid/npm/normalize-package-data#what-normalization-currently-entails) the package data.
